steps.content: ... Voyager from distant lands, open your eyes.
If you don't...
[Wake-Up Effect] The black CG overlay fades away. Sound effect: a crisp notification sound similar to light tapping on porcelain.
Groggily, you feel occasional warm touches against your skin. The warmth doesn't feel like a living thing, but more like some kind of... congealing balmy substance.
After a moment of scalding heat, your skin tightens strangely. The dense warmth feels like countless tiny hands tickling you all at once, creating a numbing and itchy sensation.

You struggle to open your eyes, and instantly, a young girl's face fills your entire vision. Her features are exquisite like a doll, but her porcelain skin is covered in fine cracks, looking like she might shatter at the slightest touch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmph...!

Her eerie closeness jolts you into full alertness, and you become aware of a strange hardening sensation on your arm—it's wax! Several drops of semi-solidified white candle wax are burning into your skin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Can't you just wake people up normally?
Before you can finish your complaint, a warm yet slightly stiff hand grasps yours.
A strange sense of comfort washes over you. It must be one of the other players who entered the room with you. However, when you turn to look, the words of relief immediately freeze in your throat.

What's holding your hand is... a quietly burning candle in the shape of a hand! The cut on its "wrist" is clean, and the small flame even bounces cheerfully after noticing your gaze, as if saying hello. It even adjusts the tiny bow tied around its "wrist" with its deft fingers, then extends itself to you in a most gentlemanly manner.
You instantly pull back your hand. The candle hand wobbles from the sudden movement, its flame flickering several times.
It retreats like a frightened small animal, crawling back into the girl's hand. Large drops of wax tears fall as its flame shrinks, as if silently accusing your rudeness.
Somehow, you manage to return its handshake. The candle hand's flame goes "poof" and shoots up a bit higher, brighter, and more stable than before.
It happily shakes your clasped hands up and down, completing a proper handshake dance before retreating to the girl's palm contentedly, its flame bobbing proudly.
Having received thorough fire safety training, you instinctively pinch out the flame.

With a "poof," the flame goes out and a wisp of smoke rises. The candle hand freezes instantly. Then, like a cat whose tail has been stepped on, it arches its palm and springs away from you quickly. Cautiously avoiding you, it darts back to the girl's palm in a flash, nuzzling her fingers indignantly.

The girl says nothing, but the reproach in her eyes is clear as day. She sticks out her finger and gently stirs the extinguished wick. The flame is finally relit, flickering weakly. You exhale with relief.
You scratch your head awkwardly, inwardly marveling at how realistically this little gadget is made. Even without a face, it manages to convey emotions so effectively.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who are you? Where is everybody?
You look around. It's still the same hot spring pool, but something is clearly off.
The other guests... are already waiting in the lobby. Rumina will guide you. Please follow me.

She sounds like a well-trained attendant, her voice soft yet completely flat. You stand and follow her, then notice you're wearing an entirely different outfit now, though the style seems oddly familiar.
The moment you take a step, there's a very faint sound under your feet. Several translucent flakes of wax shake loose from your pants, falling into the bath and quickly melting away, disappearing.

You want to stop the attendant named Rumina to ask for an explanation, but your attention is drawn to the candle hand perched on her shoulder. It has been twisting its "body" to silently "watch" you, and now it's urging you to keep up by blinking its flame.
You swallow the unspoken questions and decide to follow along first.
[Scene Change] Lobby

The lobby has a vintage design, like something you'd find in a mansion. The three people who were waiting with you earlier are already seated. Seeing that everyone has arrived, Rumina gently claps her hands.
Darkness descends. An eerily beautiful flower suddenly blooms in the dark, its radiance illuminating the text floating in the air.
[Scene Change] CG large flower background, text centered on full screen

On the border of a kingdom ravaged by calamity and curse, there lies a strange town shrouded in eternal mist.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Legend says it is a sanctuary blessed by the Witch of Rewind. Many have crossed the barren wasteland, arriving with their scars and desperate hopes.

Yet the Witch's favor is not bestowed easily. You must cleanse the shadows of your past and endure the trial of the three moonrises and moonsets. Pass the Witch's Trial, and you shall remain; fail, and you shall forever be trapped between cycles, utterly forsaken by reality.
You write your own story. You seek your own truth...
[End CG Background]
The light fades completely as candlelight returns to the room, as if the vision you just witnessed never happened.
You instinctively search for the source of the voice. A hidden speaker, perhaps? But looking around, you can't find any trace of modern technology anywhere.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who was speaking just now?
In response to your question, Rumina doesn't speak. She simply raises her index finger gently to her lips.

The candle hand, meanwhile, seems utterly exasperated as it covers its candle "face." The candle equivalent of a facepalm, you suppose. Strange as it is, you immediately get the message: Asking a question like that in a supposedly immersive game isn't appropriate.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: The cycle has begun. Dear guests... may all your wishes come true.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Rumina will be waiting for you here... always.
And with that, she and the candle hand silently retreat into the shadows and vanish. Just before disappearing, the candle hand even bows to say goodbye.
After Rumina's departure, the tension in the lobby seems to dissipate, finally giving you a chance to examine your surroundings carefully.

This is a hot spring inn converted from an ancient castle. The lobby stretches two stories high, furnished with solid antique pieces made of fine materials that have visibly aged with time. There are no lamps or signs of electricity anywhere. The only illumination comes from candelabras of various sizes scattered throughout the inn.

Eleanor can no longer contain her curiosity, touching and examining everything around her. First, she runs her fingers over the leather sofa, then gasps quietly in admiration at the numerous brass candelabras.

Nearby, your burly companion is somehow already equipped with a heavy ax. He unconsciously runs his thumb over the junction where the blade meets the wooden handle, the earlier hesitation in his eyes now replaced by steady confidence and subtle excitement.
A metal name tag has appeared at his waist, with the word "Butcher" clearly engraved on it.
Meanwhile, Ezra stands quietly to the side, his earlier nervousness completely gone, his demeanor now gentle and serene. Similarly, a name tag that says "Clergyman" is pinned to his chest.
He quietly observes his surroundings, fingers occasionally pushing up the bridge of his nose unconsciously. His expression is complex, wavering between compassion and scrutiny.
You look down and notice something on your chest as well...
[Insert special portrait - Adventurer name tag]
It's a metal name tag like the ones worn by the others, hanging there as if it has belonged to you from the very beginning.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...<color=#fb9259>Voyager</color>?
Is this your assigned role in this script? It's unclear how it was decided. You certainly don't remember picking a name tag.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: "Voyager," huh? That's so boring! I'd rather be an "Adventurer"!
Eleanor's name tag also hangs on her chest, with the same Disian word written on it as on yours.

It's a word that's usually a synonym for "traveler," but can also mean "adventurer." You and Eleanor have different interpretations of the same noun, resulting in two distinct identities. Hmm, interesting.

But regardless, compared to "Butcher" and "Clergyman," the role assigned to you two definitely makes you seem like noobs. Could these mysterious name tags have chosen their wearers? Curiously, you remove the tag to examine it and discover a line of small text on the back: Find your own goal.

The name tag, the goal... You recall reading the Player Guidelines on the back of your ticket while waiting outside. You think it mentioned something about each player receiving an identity and a game objective. Is this what it meant?
Still, isn't it a bit odd that the game objective is literally just "find your own goal"? Perhaps you should check what's written on the backs of the others' name tags as well.

However, the others haven't removed their name tags, much less shown any interest in conversation. You want to read what's written on the ticket again, but your hand comes up empty when you reach into your pocket.

Your gaze sweeps across this eerie lobby once more. The grandfather clock indicates it's now three in the afternoon. Outside the windows, ever-present thick fog shrouds the silhouette of a town slumbering in shadows.
The burly man named Clay lets out a shout.

steps.speaker: Clay
steps.content: Ha! The mightiest butcher, the Protector of Cirrenfold, is setting out!
While his echo still reverberates through the forest, he grips his ax and strides away in another direction, his final words dissipating in the air.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Wow... <color=#fb9259>The moment he put on that name tag, he became an entirely different person</color>. How does he get into character so quickly? That's a veteran player for you.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: By the way, haven't we got another teammate? That guy with glasses... What was his name again?
Glasses smiles, and sporting his "Clergyman" name tag, the previously quiet and timid guy now suddenly appears wise and composed.
He bows to you both, then leaves without a word.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Ohh, awesome! Things are heating up! I'll head out too! Here comes my new adventure! Let's go!
Eleanor tugs at you excitedly before rushing out of the inn. In the blink of an eye, you're the only one left inside.

The name tags appearing from nowhere, the unforthcoming companions, the different missions assigned to everyone... Everything seems like a mystery. But it's precisely why this fog-shrouded town seems all the more compelling to explore.
Well, you came here to unwind and have fun. Guess you should just try and enjoy this leisurely adventure into the unknown.
